# Shell polish media (#443)

Captured from a local stack with headless Chromium driving the real app: a fresh sign-up through the email code, fictional `@example.test` people, desktop 1280×800.

| File | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| `en-desktop-footer.png` | The account footer straight away: initials from the email ("AD") and the email as the name, never "U / Account". |
| `en-desktop-account-menu.png` | The account menu: Account settings, Interface language, Theme (Light / Dark / Match my device), Help and documentation, What's new, Keyboard shortcuts, Report a problem. |
| `en-desktop-language-dialog-from-enter.png` | Interface language opened **with the keyboard** (Enter on the menu item); the dialog stays open (WORKSPACE-17). |
| `en-desktop-keyboard-shortcuts.png` | The new Keyboard shortcuts dialog, also opened with Enter. |
| `en-desktop-palette-domain.png` | "domain" outside a website: Site settings first, one Custom domain row (WORKSPACE-16). |
| `en-desktop-palette-invite.png` | "invite" outside a website finds Invite people (organization Members). |
| `ar-desktop-account-menu.png` | The same menu in Arabic, mirrored. |
| `ar-desktop-palette-domain.png` | The palette in Arabic. |
| `walkthrough-account-menu-and-palette.webm` | The whole run: sign-in, footer, keyboard-only menu and dialogs, palette, Arabic. |
